Implementation Plan

Implementation Plan — Item 13 (`reclarify` prior-round context)

Clarification answer interpretation:
- No Q<ID> clarification questions were asked in this planning context.
- `/answer [auto-answered-by-clarify]` indicates the clarify phase auto-confirmed sufficiency, so planning can proceed without additional clarifications.

Conflict detected:
- `prompts/mode-clarify-inline.txt` is not a tracked prompt file in this repo.
- Canonical runtime prompt source is the inline heredoc in `.github/workflows/clarify.yml` (`Run Codex` step writing `${RUNTIME_DIR}/mode-clarify-inline.txt`).

1. Files likely to change
- `.github/workflows/clarify.yml`

2. Functions/modules to implement
- Extend the `Build context file` logic to conditionally append a prior-round section only for `/reclarify` runs.
- Add parsing logic (same step or a dedicated preceding step) to extract:
  - Most recent prior clarification question block.
  - Most recent `/answer` body tied to that prior round.
  - A composed optional block:
    - `=== PRIOR CLARIFICATION ROUND ===`
    - Previous questions
    - User answers
    - Why these were insufficient (placeholder text).
- Update the inline clarify prompt text in `Run Codex` to explicitly instruct:
  - Do not repeat already answered questions.
  - Ask only unresolved gaps.
- Reuse parsing patterns already used in `.github/workflows/plan.yml` (“Extract clarification answers and questions”) for robust `/answer` extraction and fail-open behavior.

3. Data structures affected
- `ISSUE_CONTEXT_FILE` text format gains an optional appended section for re-clarify runs:
  - Existing `ISSUE DESCRIPTION` + `ISSUE COMMENTS` remain unchanged.
  - New optional `=== PRIOR CLARIFICATION ROUND ===` block appended after comments.
- New transient shell variables in clarify workflow (example intent): re-clarify flag, prior question text, prior answer text, composed block text.
- No DB contract, collection, or index changes.

4. API/interface changes
- No trigger/command changes: `/reclarify` and `/answer` semantics remain intact.
- Internal prompt contract changes for clarify model input:
  - Prior-round context included only on `/reclarify`.
  - First-time clarify (`issues.opened`) omits prior-round block entirely.

5. Potential risks or edge cases
- Prior comments not parseable or missing expected markers.
- Multiple clarification cycles: must select only the most recent prior round.
- Auto-generated answers (e.g., `[auto-answered-by-clarify]`) may contain minimal content.
- Comment window (`per_page=50`) may not include old rounds on very long threads.
- False-positive question extraction from unrelated bot comments.
- Mitigation: fail-open parsing (skip prior block if extraction is uncertain) and continue normal clarify flow.

6. Testing considerations
- Smoke test flow (acceptance-focused):
  - Open issue requiring clarification.
  - Verify first clarify run has no prior-round block.
  - Reply with `/answer ...`.
  - Trigger `/reclarify`.
  - Verify re-clarify context includes `=== PRIOR CLARIFICATION ROUND ===` with previous questions and answer body.
  - Verify follow-up questions differ from already answered ones.
- Regression checks:
  - Clear-path auto-post `/answer [auto-answered-by-clarify]` still works.
  - No behavior change for first-time clarify runs.
  - Parse failures do not fail workflow (fail-open preserved).

To proceed reply:

/approved

To restart clarification reply:

/reclarify
